lia_sales: Quick sync  Prospect Helios wants a short POC with a committed capacity option. They expect steady ~330 QPS and bursts up to ~1.9k QPS for paid campaigns. Mix: ~58% chat (avg 130 tokens) + 42% embeddings. Need recommended reserved GPU count, autoscale/fallback plan, preheat estimate, and a pricing framing that avoids surprise overages.
owen_sre: Which region/model and any compliance asks? Concurrency per session?
paz_eng: Pinned model: redwood/llm-7b-quantized in eu-west-1. Peak concurrency ~1,200, steady ~320. They require KMS + audit logs (HIPAA-like compliance).
ryan_solution: Customer wants predictability. Suggested structure: reserved GPUs for steady load + capped burst credits + optional preheat block for campaign start. Also ask how we guarantee p99 if they buy preheat.
lia_sales: Exactly  they want an explicit p99 protection clause if preheat purchased.
owen_sre: Quick sizing: mixed effective throughput ~= 62 qps/GPU on A100-80 for that mix. For steady 330 -> round to 6 GPUs reserved. Peak 1900 -> ~31 GPUs total, so plan reserve 6 + burst up to 25. Autoscale policy should be fast scale-up (~60s) and conservative scale-down (~10min) to avoid churn.
paz_eng: Recommend model-variant fallback: route overflow to llm-7b-q4f16 when saturated. Use a 10% canary during spikes to check quality drift, escalate to configurable max (30-50%) if metrics acceptable. Include a quality-delta disclaimer in the contract.
ryan_solution: Preheat plan: warm common KV prefixes. Estimate ~200M tokens -> ~3-4 GPU-hours per region. Recommend 4-6 hours preheat window before major campaigns. If they require cross-region replication that doubles preheat and replication cost.
owen_sre: Ops caveats: p99 SLA conditioned on reserved capacity + preheat purchase and KV hit-rate >= 75%. Cold-start spikes may violate p99; document in SLA appendix. Also recommend AZ spread for reserved nodes (min 3 AZs for resilience).
paz_eng: Short config snippet for appendix: 
```
reserved_nodes: 6
min_nodes: 6
max_nodes: 31
scale_up: {threshold_qps: 400, cooldown_sec: 60}
scale_down: {threshold_qps: 260, cooldown_sec: 600}
fallback: {variant: llm-7b-q4f16, canary_pct: 10, max_pct: 40}
```
ryan_solution: Pricing proposal lanes: 1) Baseline month: 6 reserved GPUs at R/mo. 2) Campaign week: reserved + burst pool (up to 25 GPUs billed at burst rate B/hr). 3) Worst-case sustained: includes emergency mitigation (throttling, paging) and shows cost if burst cap exceeded. Add one-time preheat block (6 GPU-hrs) as optional add-on and a Private/VPC surcharge for KMS/audit.
lia_sales: Legal flagged a clause: what if an AZ goes down mid-campaign? They want explicit runbook and cost/latency implications.
owen_sre: Recommend AZ spread for reserved nodes; in AZ outage route to remaining AZs and enable regional fallback if needed. Regional fallback requires replicated KV and doubles preheat cost; include that tradeoff.
paz_eng: I'll prepare an engineering appendix with per-GPU throughput & tail-latency table for 6/12/20/31 nodes, preheat token/time estimates, and a short eval plan for fallback quality monitoring.
ryan_solution: I'll translate the appendix into three pricing scenarios and draft the conditional p99 language (requires preheat + KV hit rate threshold).
lia_sales: Ops-bot please create follow-up ticket and I'll schedule the customer call for Thu 11am CET.
ops-bot: Created ticket #PR-11901: "Helios POC  sizing appendix + preheat runbook + KMS SLA wording" assigned to paz_eng, owen_sre, ryan_solution, due 2026-04-20. :white_check_mark:
lia_sales: Thanks team 44d We'll finalize docs and loop in Legal before the customer meeting.
